svg.text: Project Circle · level layout proposal v0.1 · schematic, not to scale · every name and boss below is a proposal

g.text: 1 Discard Pit — start. Where unwanted shapes are thrown.
Tutorial: move, jump, dash, cape attack.
2 Old Triangle's Hollow — first Mirror. The Old
3 Scalene Slums — lowest-rank village, under the
whisper. The first village to free.
4 BOSS 1 · The Base Warden — gatekeeper who keeps
the low ranks below. Lasers + slams. Vertex Seal I.
Beating it frees the Slums (they become allies).
5 Isosceles Terraces — middle-rank tiers to climb.
6 BOSS 2 · The Twin Isosceles — duo: one lasers
while the other pounces. Vertex Seal II.
7 Whispering Fissure — a crack through the strata.
Dash through crumbling walls. Corruption visuals.
8 Prism Caverns — crystal caves, bent lasers.
9 BOSS 3 · The Refractor — splits into homing orbs
(dodge with double jump / dash). Vertex Seal III.
10 Rank Gate — only opens for 3 vertices. The three
Seals form a triangle for the vertex-less circle.
12 FINAL · The Hierarch — most perfect triangle,
wholly under the Shapeshifter. Apex Throne.
13 Temple of Three Points — sacred temple behind
the throne. The Triangle Mould: become a triangle
for a while — the Madness Bar fills.
14 Road to the Square Realm — exit, next world.
Broken Vertex Graveyard — snapped-off corners of
cast-out triangles, piled high. Lore tablets.
Shrine of the First Break (secret, M) — where the
first triangle lost a vertex: origin of the outcast law.
Proving Ring (Arena A, P) — triangles fight for rank.
Wave arena; entry over a spike pit (pogo).
Shatter Grounds (Arena B) — elite gauntlet, harder
Square's Refuge (hidden, J) — the Square, hidden from
the Shapeshifter's awareness. Becomes an ally.
Hall of Measure — where triangles are measured and
ranked. Bureaucrat NPC; the discrimination theme.
Fissure, late game (purple !) — the Old Triangle,
now fully corrupted: story scene or fight.
• Rank = height. The circle starts at the very bottom
and climbs the hierarchy that threw it away.
• 3 bosses → 3 Vertex Seals → Rank Gate → final boss
• Each freed village becomes an ally and weakens
the Shapeshifter's hold on the region.
• The Mould unlocks M gates back in the lowlands,
rewarding a return to where the journey began.
Mechanics already in the prototype: dash, cape attack
+ pogo, cape-platform double jump, Mirrors, dialogue,
